AAF.caption: Language
AAF.doc: Language to display. Must be in ISO 639 2-letter format (eg: 'en', 'fr')
AAF.name: language

AAG.caption: Fallback Language
AAG.doc: Fallback language if there is no value for the language selected. Must be in ISO 639 2-letter format (eg: 'en', 'fr')
AAG.name: fallback_language

AAH.caption: Values
AAH.doc: List of keys/values, keys must be ISO 639 2-letters format.
AAH.name: values
